candidate.initial_summary: Common hold-initial velocity solver supporting finite original arrays and generated public oracles.

agents.name: Broad NS solver explorer
agents.prompt:
Focus primarily on exploring new approaches to the task. Pursue the ideas you judge most promising for producing a stronger program. Use the current program and available evidence as context, and follow useful findings wherever they lead. You have full freedom to choose methods, representations, and experiments, including combining new ideas with improvements to existing approaches.

NS task and public inputs
-------------------------
Build a solver for the supplied incompressible Navier--Stokes Cases, supporting
both public input representations. Generated Cases expose the domain and public
query_initial_velocity/query_forcing Oracles. Original numerical Cases expose
public_data['question'] and ['arrays']: x[X], y[Y], t[T],
initial_velocity[2,X,Y], forcing[T,2,X,Y], and fluid_mask[X,Y].
Both representations describe the declared NS equation. The supplied S0
illustrates support for both input paths.

Selection objective
-------------------
At each round boundary, Promotion evaluates each Agent's final nominated
program and the entering incumbent on the same 192 hidden Cases within this run:
64 clean Base, 64 Guided, 64 Base-perturbed, and 0 Guided-perturbed.
Minimize overall.mean: the unweighted mean of the 192
per-Case u/v-component relative L2 errors, without truncation. Execution or
nonfinite failures make a program ineligible; exact ties retain the incumbent.
The Base and Base-perturbed Cases are frozen and shared across runs for the
corresponding round. Guided evaluation Cases use this run's entering incumbent
as their guidance reference and can differ across runs. All candidates within
the same run and round share the complete Official suite. Pressure is unscored.

Development tools: Base, Guided and Perturbed. Each round starts with 32 Cases and allows at most 512 total new Cases per Agent, including starter and perturbed children. Choose your own timing, quantities and experiments. Use the previous selected program and cumulative Campaign Memory; Develop and test as many versions as useful within your budget. Each submit replaces your own nominated representative; at the round boundary only your last committed nomination enters Promotion. Choose your strongest program using development evidence and submit it before finishing. To select an earlier version, submit it again last. Earlier versions and research logs remain archived.
